Description
This bright 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom, 1,041 sq. ft. south-facing suite at Park West II offers stunning views from every room, with floor-to-ceiling windows, a spacious and functional layout with a cozy fireplace, generous pantry and storage, in-suite laundry, a covered balcony, and A/C for added summer comfort. Enjoy exceptional resort-style amenities including an indoor lap pool, sauna, steam room, hot tub, fitness centre, squash court, theatre, guest suite, concierge service and more. Ideally located just steps from the Seawall, George Wainborn Park, David Lam Park, Urban Fare and Yaletown’s finest restaurants, with shopping, cafés and entertainment right at your doorstep. One secure parking stall included.
